name: {NICKNAME}
desc: A {F#girl}{M#boy} who boarded the Astral Express.\n{F#She}{M#He} chose to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the dangers posed by the Stellaron.

voicelines.voice_m: When there is the chance to make a choice, make one that you know you won't regret...
What kind of a life would I have lived if I didn't choose to board the Express... No, there is no such possibility.
They may sound annoyed, but their body language is more honest. I should visit Pom-Pom more often.
My weapon is also one of the Curios of the space station. I don't know where it came from, but it must be important if it appeals to Madam Herta.
Just where did the will of Destruction come from? Was it really because of the Stellaron within me...?
Just like me, the people of Belobog are also seeing the native sky of this planet for the first time.
The seed of Preservation has always been within Belobog, and I simply re-ignited this city's will to live... That will may be weak, but this was not the time for it to go out.
In Penacony, Mikhail has long spent his life embodying the precious legacy of the Watchmaker... Only when one wakes up can one bring the dreams of the night into the daylight.
I have had my fair share of strife and conflict with others, but I am willing to put that aside for now and look toward our shared future, where fortuitous destinies intersect.

The heroic epic has already been written. In this world that even Akivili did not reach, we were able to walk as the Nameless with the people of Amphoreus, bearing witness to the indelible marks that each person made in this book.

Things that I thought I had forgotten, in fact, never left me. They are the opening lines of the poem, and with every stop on the Trailblazing journey, they will continue to write even more romantic chapters.
Choice isn't as elusive as it seems.
The value of choice lies in unwavering resolve.
Unknown to each other, yet united in purpose, we make the same choices.
Do not give up on making a choice, even if you're about to be forgotten.
Joy or pain... What matters is that we're the ones making the call.
Preservation is determined by our actions.
Before our paths diverge, savor the shared journey.
We remember the past to walk into the future.
The destination isn't the prize. The joy's in the journey itself.
March, lead the counterattack. I believe in you.

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Dan Heng
voicelines.voice_m: Dan Heng, let's make this quick.

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae
voicelines.voice_m: Like always, Dan Heng, let's make this quick!
I'm counting on you to wrap this up, Himeko.
I'm on it, Wel—... Ahem, Mr. Yang.
An unexpected sight... but this is also what it means to Trailblaze.
Same as always? Beat them down as they come, right?

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
voicelines.voice_m: Let's keep trailblazing together, Dan Heng!
Let's work together for a golden future.
This time, we will walk forward together, hand in hand.
I look forward to your performance this time.
Thank you for the colors you've scattered across the world, Hyacine.
Shall we split the spoils thirty-seventy? As to who gets the seventy, I'm open to negotiations.
The road to becoming a hero is not a lonely one, partner.
The feast is here. Let the music of triumph ring out.
Lead us in a charge once more, O Imperator!
I shall remember. I shall press on. Let's walk towards the stars together, Cyrene.
Rules are made to be broken!
Time to go on the offensive.
Don't miss the best timing for an attack.
The mood is set just right.
Let's try it this other way...
Is this how it feels to be in sync?
Well... I'm not in a hurry anyway.
This story... is as we've written!
Let's write an ending like never before!
Trust me, you can do it.
Wanna knock me down? It's not that easy.
That's all it takes to rattle you?
From now on, address me as... the Galactic Twincleaver!
All martial arts, are mine to command... You're done!
Your moment to shine. Light it up!
Right now, the stage is yours!
Didn't see that coming? The crowd loves a good plot twist.
Thanks, now I can go another five hundred years.
Reach the end of the story in your own way.
It's still early. Where to now?

1.name: A Falling Star
1.desc: When enemies are defeated due to the Trailblazer's Ultimate, the Trailblazer regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> extra Energy. This effect can only be triggered once per attack.

2.name: An Unwilling Host

3.name: A Leading Whisper
3.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

4.name: A Destructing Glance
4.desc: When attacking an enemy that is <u>Weakness Broken</u>, increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

10000006.name: Weakness Break State
10000006.desc: When enemy targets' Toughness is reduced to 0, they will enter the Weakness Break State, which delays their actions.

5.name: A Surviving Hope
5.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

6.name: A Trailblazing Will
6.desc: The Trailblazer's Talent is also triggered when they defeat an enemy.

800101.simple_desc: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy.

800102.name: RIP Home Run
800102.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.
800102.simple_desc: Deals Physical DMG to one enemy and enemies adjacent to it.

800103.name: Stardust Ace

800103.simple_desc: Uses Single Target ATK or Blast to strike with full force.

800104.name: Perfect Pickoff
800104.desc: Each time after this character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, ATK increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. This effect stacks up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).
800104.simple_desc: Every time this unit breaks an enemy target's Weakness, ATK increases.

800106.name: Attack
800106.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

800107.name: Immortal Third Strike
800107.desc: Immediately heals all allies for <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of their respective Max HP after using this Technique.
800107.simple_desc: After using Technique, immediately <color=#f29e38ff>restores HP</color> for team.

800108.name: Blowout: Farewell Hit
800108.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
800108.simple_desc: Deals massive Physical DMG to one enemy.

800109.name: Blowout: RIP Home Run
800109.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.
800109.simple_desc: Deals Physical DMG to one enemy and enemies adjacent to it.
